cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(osc_core LANGUAGES C)
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD 99)
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
add_library(osc_core src/controller.c)
target_include_directories(osc_core PUBLIC include)
if(MSVC)
  target_compile_options(osc_core PRIVATE /W4 /WX)
else()
  target_compile_options(osc_core PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Werror -pedantic)
endif()
enable_testing()
add_executable(test_controller ../../tests/test_controller.c)
target_link_libraries(test_controller PRIVATE osc_core)
add_test(NAME controller_lockout COMMAND test_controller)
# board_pins.h is generated by tools/build_board_model.py from the netlists.
add_executable(test_board_pins ../../tests/test_board_pins.c)
target_include_directories(test_board_pins PRIVATE include)
if(MSVC)
  target_compile_options(test_board_pins PRIVATE /W4 /WX)
else()
  target_compile_options(test_board_pins PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Werror -pedantic)
endif()
add_test(NAME board_pins_distinct COMMAND test_board_pins)
# BSP and main loop on the simulator's host HAL (sim/README.md, F1); the
# tests in tests/sim build the same sources with sim/osc_sim/firmware.py.
add_library(osc_sim_fw SHARED src/controller.c src/bsp.c src/app.c ../common/proto.c ../../sim/hal/hal_sim.c)
target_include_directories(osc_sim_fw PRIVATE include ../common ../../sim/hal)
if(MSVC)
  target_compile_options(osc_sim_fw PRIVATE /W4 /WX)
else()
  target_compile_options(osc_sim_fw PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Werror -pedantic)
endif()
# ESP32 interface core on its host HAL (F2), and the protocol it shares.
add_library(osc_sim_esp SHARED ../esp32/core/frontpanel.c ../esp32/core/display.c ../esp32/core/esp_app.c
            ../common/proto.c ../../sim/hal/hal_esp_sim.c)
target_include_directories(osc_sim_esp PRIVATE ../esp32/core ../esp32/main ../common ../../sim/hal)
add_executable(test_proto ../../tests/test_proto.c ../common/proto.c)
target_include_directories(test_proto PRIVATE ../common)
foreach(t osc_sim_esp test_proto)
  if(MSVC)
    target_compile_options(${t} PRIVATE /W4 /WX)
  else()
    target_compile_options(${t} PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Werror -pedantic)
  endif()
endforeach()
add_test(NAME protocol_v0 COMMAND test_proto)
